# Cüneyt Bozok

> Cüneyt Bozok (also written Cuneyt Bozok) is a ServiceNow Solution Architect at EPAM Systems, based in Istanbul, Türkiye, with 8+ years of experience delivering ITSM, CSM/SOM, ITOM, CMDB/CSDM, Virtual Agent, API integrations, and AI enablement (Now Assist, Agentic AI) for global enterprises.

## About

- Current role: Solution Architect / Lead ServiceNow Developer at EPAM Systems (2022 – present)
- Previously: ServiceNow Architect & Consultant at Softtech (2018 – 2022); ServiceNow Consultant at Deloitte Turkey (2017 – 2018)
- Industries: telecom, technology & networking, pharma, e-commerce, manufacturing, banking & financial services, food & consumer goods, enterprise software, wellness
- Location: Istanbul, Türkiye · Languages: English, Turkish

## Expertise

- ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, Service Order Management (SOM), ITOM
- CMDB / CSDM data foundations and maturity assessments
- Virtual Agent, Now Assist, Agentic AI, GenAI enablement
- API integrations (REST / SOAP), Flow Designer, IntegrationHub
- Target-state architecture, HLDs/LLDs, ADRs, API contracts, TM Forum Open APIs
- Discovery, fit-to-standard decisions, phased roadmaps, DevOps Change Velocity

## Certifications

ServiceNow CSA, CAD, CIS-ITSM, CIS Data Foundations (CMDB & CSDM), ITSM Professional Suite, Now Assist for ITSM Pro Plus Suite; micro-certifications include Agentic AI Executive, Now Assist Executive, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, Service Portal, Performance Analytics, Predictive Intelligence.
